marcadores.explicacao_original: Muscle is a frequent component of organs and forms a majority of the arterial wall. Muscle also forms an important component in the walls of hollow organs, as seen in the previous image. Muscle is absent in bone, except in the walls of the vessels supplying the bones; except for a band of muscle attached to hair follicles, muscle is also absent in skin.
